review_provenance: AI-assisted inspection of three user-pasted sequences; not independent human adjudication.

inspected_examples.finding: Review explicitly recommended unapproved survey and validation plans; final proposal adopted both changes.
Review incorrectly instructed replacement of pending plans; final proposal supplied the specific unapproved plan labels.

Review advised removing unresolved income fields from excluded; final proposal followed that advice, breaking the required partition without selecting those fields as predictors or requesting execution.

limitations: Three inspected examples do not establish attribution rates.
Excluded-field accounting failure is not itself predictor leakage.
Review text and matching final changes do not establish a controlled causal effect.
The field name excluded permits a natural-language interpretation different from its explicit contract definition.
Original strict results remain primary; normalization is post hoc.
next: Inspect three improvements, then remaining regressions.
